_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Spectrum Certification Spectral Characteristics Data
summary: Certifies spectrum support and spectral characteristics data for major spectrum-dependent systems and equipment, as required prior to authorization to operate under DoDI 4650.01 and related spectrum management regulations.
use_relationship:
Section 305 and chapter 8 of title 47, United States Code, Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Circular A-11, Part 2, Sec. 33.4, and the Manual of Regulations and Procedures for Radio Frequency Management require certification of spectrum support prior to authorization to operate for experimental testing (Stage 2), developmental testing (Stage 3), or operation (Stage 4) of new major spectrum-dependent (S-D) systems and equipment.

DoDI 4650.01 requires Spectrum Supportability Risk Assessments (SSRAs) to be performed by DoD components for all S-D systems and equipment to identify risks as early as possible and affect design and procurement decisions. As indicated below, these risks are reviewed at each acquisition milestone (MS) and are managed throughout the system's lifecycle.

The DD Form 1494 provides the means for the Department of Defense to evaluate Spectrum Supportability Compliance throughout the life cycle of a system or equipment.
a. This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for data resulting from the work task described by 5.15 of MIL-STD-464 and is intended for contractor furnished S-D equipment employed on airborne, sea, space, and ground systems.
b. An Application for Equipment Frequency Allocation (DD Form 1494) is required for each contractor-furnished S-D equipment.
c. This DID is related to DI-81540B, DI-EMCS-81541B and DI-EMCS-81542B.
d. This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81174.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, or revisions, shall be as cited in the solicitation or contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format and content.
preparation_instructions.content: The format and content shall be in accordance with the instructions on the back of DD Form 1494.

preparation_instructions.title: Other information sources.
preparation_instructions.content: When other information sources contain data required by this DID, these sources shall be referenced and the data incorporated into the DD Form 1494. How copies of the referenced documents can be obtained shall be stated.
